notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list places a tower here; no source we read says a structure stands or stood on the summit, and no build, staffing or fire record was found. The list's name 'elsberry mtn' is the compiler's label (towers 73+), and the list does not say the entry sits on the summit. Units: the list gives elevation with no unit; 1,302 is read as feet, which matches the record's 396.9 m. Heights: Wikipedia Dallas gives 1,310 ft (400 m), so the two figures differ by 8 ft if the list is in feet. Search snippets gave 1,286 and 1,289 ft but were not read, so they are not cited. NHLR: the Georgia page's full list of 29 names was read on 2026-10-21; none is Elsberry. Leads not read: a Georgia Archives historic-preservation file titled 'Cell Tower: Elsberry, Paulding Meadows Park, Dallas' (georgiaarchives.as.atlas-sys.com, archival object 452082), which may be an unrelated telecom site; Zillow/Realtor pages for 1 Elsberry Mountain Rd (vacant lot) say nothing about a tower. Access, status and visit fields stay unknown.
